patterns.note: Asymmetrical product grids are used, often mixing large lifestyle images with smaller product shots within 'Shop the Look' sections, creating dynamic visual interest.
The brand logo uses a unique, handwritten script font, creating a strong brand identity that contrasts with the clean, utilitarian sans-serif used for all other text elements.
The palette is predominantly monochromatic (white, black, greys) allowing the rich, earthy tones and textures of the product photography to provide visual interest and color.

The hero section features a full-bleed video or image that subtly parallaxes, moving slower than the scroll, while content sections below reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Product display sections often feature full-bleed photography with minimal text overlays, emphasizing the visual appeal and quality of the garments over detailed descriptions.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely using `locomotive-scroll`, which provides a fluid and enhanced scroll feel across the page.
Scroll-triggered animations are used to progressively reveal content sections as they enter the viewport, typically with a subtle fade-in or vertical slide-up effect.
The hero element utilizes a video or large image with a subtle parallax effect, where the background content moves at a slower rate than the foreground as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are typically uppercase sans-serif, slightly larger than body text but not dramatically so, maintaining a clean and understated hierarchy. The logo is a distinct, decorative script.

standout: The site's standout feature is its blend of high-quality, editorial-style product photography and video with a minimalist, almost stark, interface. The distinctive, handwritten-style logo provides a unique brand identity that contrasts with the otherwise clean and utilitarian typography, giving it a personal, artisanal touch within a sophisticated e-commerce framework.
